test_GenericModel_forward_backward: test the GenericModel forward and backward pass with random camera inputs and training evaluation modes
test_GenericModel_all_configs: test all GenericModel configurations from implicitron_trainer YAML config files with forward and backward passes
test_GenericModel_IDR: test the GenericModel forward pass with SignedDistanceFunctionRenderer and IdrFeatureField implicit function settings
